card.does: Stores electricity and gives it out through plus and minus.
card.needs: Needs: a loop of wire from plus, through a part, back to minus.
card.popularMechanics: One cell like this runs a wall clock for months.
card.safetyNote: Real battery packs need an adult nearby: never join plus to minus with a bare wire.

failureModes.cardLine: Short circuit: the battery pack drains fast.
failureModes.hint: Plus is joined straight to minus
failureModes.teachingNote: A path from plus back to minus with nothing that uses power on it, such as a bare wire, a closed switch or a pack of another voltage side by side, gives the current nothing to slow it, so the pack empties in seconds and grows warm.

failureModes.cardLine: No loop: nothing on the battery pack works.
failureModes.hint: This battery pack has no loop back to minus
failureModes.teachingNote: A battery pack gives power only round a closed loop from plus back to minus. With no loop at all nothing flows, so nothing on it works.
